personal.bioHeading: Crafting production-ready web applications, microservices, and AI-driven systems with high performance and efficiency.
bioParagraphs: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience designing scalable backend architectures using Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and TypeScript.

At Uttaranchal University, I engineer microservices, automate CMS operations with n8n and AI workflows (reducing manual effort by 70% and boosting productivity by 40%), and deploy production web portals via GitHub Actions CI/CD to VPS servers.
Additionally, I build AI-powered applications utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), pgvector semantic search, and Groq & Gemini LLM APIs.

projects.title: Pragati – Centralized Administrative Portal
projects.tagline: Centralized Internal Portal for IQAC Department with Automated VPS CI/CD
projects.description: A centralized administrative portal for university management using Node.js microservices, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions automated VPS deployment.
projects.fullDescription: Pragati is a centralized internal portal designed and developed for Uttaranchal University's IQAC department to streamline administrative operations. Built with a microservices architecture using Node.js and Express.js, backed by PostgreSQL, containerized with Docker and Docker Compose, and continuously deployed to a local VPS server via GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. Improved overall administrative efficiency by 30%.
keyFeatures: Designed and developed centralized portal for IQAC department
Containerized microservices using Docker and orchestrated deployments with Docker Compose
Built complete CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions to automatically deploy updates to local VPS server
Improved administrative efficiency by 30% through centralized data management

projects.title: AI Resume Analyzer (RAG)
projects.tagline: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Engine with pgvector & Groq API
projects.description: An AI-powered document analysis system utilizing FastAPI, pgvector semantic search, Gemini Embeddings, and Groq API for rapid context generation.
projects.fullDescription: Built an intelligent AI-powered Resume Analyzer using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system processes resume documents using Gemini Embeddings and stores vector representations in PostgreSQL with pgvector for high-performance semantic retrieval. Integrates the Groq API for fast LLM inference and context-aware query responses, with the core RAG engine containerized via Docker.
keyFeatures: Built an AI-powered Resume Analyzer using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Implemented semantic vector search with pgvector and Gemini Embeddings for document retrieval
Integrated Groq API to generate fast, context-aware AI responses
Developed high-performance RAG backend with FastAPI containerized using Docker

Developed REST APIs for event creation, approval, scheduling, and publishing
Containerized application using Docker for consistent environment deployments
